integrity: All universal formulas derive algebraically from three short-window event probabilities and stationarity flux balance; the exact-rational verifier is a finite reproducibility check, not an infinite proof or an independent scientific assessment. Forward run-count distribution formulas are prior art; novelty concerns the inverse feasible image and minimal stationary observation.
scientific_limitations: Identification applies to exact distributional probabilities for homogeneous strictly interior first-order binary spatial Markov laws with shared initial distribution and fixed window boundary conventions; no finite-sample risk guarantees, arbitrary landscape model diagnosis, detection effects, or higher-order spatial dependence.
title: Finite-window tomography of fragmented binary habitat sequences
